resolution.reason: Reviewer re-evaluation found RF-001 was based on conflating merge-readiness conditions with the frozen specification's Chapter 12.2 projection prerequisite. Spec scope 9 requires implementation, formal V1 verification, and the implementation review to bind the current subject; it does not require code approval or Gate before projection. TASK-0017 establishes the same candidate-projection then task-local review/approval sequence.

findings.title: Chapter 12.2 completion projection precedes required review facts
